source_original.pairwise_raw_excluded_reason: 1363 pairwise observations have 18 session labels and only 138 matching main plant source keys; not part of this primary trial
source_original.paternity_1099_rows_excluded_reason: Offspring_id, known_id, candidate_id original records have no source-certified session/plant key in source-only audit.
source_original.original_study_prior_art: Original 2026 paper already reported pollinator abundance affects mate access/sexual selection; cannot claim discovery of pollen-mediated mating.

source_relationship: Single-season experimental Brassica rapa 16 pollinator-density sessions, not 16 independent fragmented landscapes; sampling 2–3 stigmas per plant and multiple seed fruits means SAME PLANT not SAME FLOWER.

source_variables.response: nbGr_mean: original number of seeds per sampled fruit, log1p response, NOT total offspring of the whole reproductive plant
source_variables.covariate_treatment: poll_treat: author experiment's bee-abundance class, categorical, one-hot across source-defined levels with first lexicographic reference; if none or >5 unique levels, STOP
source_variables.covariate_visitation: nb_visit original source plant contact count (log1p), >=0
source_variables.added_stigma_P: pl_mean: original source mean stigmatic pollen grain count sampled on flower subsample of that same (session, ID_full) plant, log1p; not compatible pollen nor paternity
source_variables.stigma_measurement_validity: Verify source flower file has same plant keys 160/160 and contain pl source column; numeric summary pl_mean is author-provided, no after-outcome construction.
source_variables.nuisance_exclusions: Exclude one plant if any response, visitation, floral display, height_max or mean stigma pollen is missing/NA/non-finite or negative; do not use separate seed data or alternative outcome. Excluded source plants remain counted in source coverage receipt; no imputation or dropping based on outcome sign.

primary.M0: intercept + treatment indicators (fixed source categories) + log1p(nb_visit) + log1p(nb_flo_all) + log1p(height_max)
primary.M1: M0 + log1p(pl_mean), one additive original direct source pollen quantity coordinate
primary.reason: Test whether measured plant-matched stigmatic pollen quantity adds out-of-sample prediction of per-fruit seed count after prior visit count, floral display and experiment density control.
primary.regression: Gaussian ridge regression on y=log1p(nbGr_mean). Fit separate ridge lambda=1.0, intercept unpenalized; train-only means and population stddev for non-intercept columns, zero stddev scaled as 1; predictions are unclipped on log1p count scale (can be negative), same for both models.
primary.holdout: leave one complete original experimental session out, all valid mother plants in each session; 16 folds total (not 160 IID plants or 18 raw pairwise sessions).
primary.loss: One squared error per originally source-eligible plant in heldout session; pooled plant-weighted MSE and MAE on log1p(nbGr_mean); record every session's n and M0/M1 losses.
primary.success_gate: M0−M1 pooled MSE >=5% of pooled M0 MSE AND M0−M1 strictly positive in >=12/16 whole-session heldout folds. Both required. No p-value from pooled 160 plants.
primary.source_coverage_stop: If <120 original plant/session keys complete, any of 16 sessions has <6 complete mothers, P source originally not measured in all 160 or source join keys drift, record COVERAGE_STOP with no trial result. Never relax after looking at outcome association.
primary.prior_registration_integrity: Protocol-only commit SHA frozen before new numeric original source model fits; code must check exact byte identity against Git ancestor. Merge must be non-squash to preserve ancestor.

secondary: A predeclared source-status descriptive comparison of number of eligible observations by bee-abundance class and original 16 sessions only. Do not choose a different reproductive metric or multi-feature pollen by results; paternity figures are prior original published analysis, not new fit.
scope: One original experimental single-site research programme from a separate 2026 paper; not a 3rd preregistered NATURAL fragmented site system.
A prospective QPF study discovery outside the original six-source research registry: do not overwrite or increment frozen six.
Original paper author reported the pollinator abundance and sexual selection mechanism; predictive gain is our own separate, conservative source-specific test.
Stigma pollen load is not genotype-compatible pollen, and seeds measured per fruit are not surviving recruits.
Strong pollinator density treatment and plant traits confound observational stimulus→seed pathway; no causal mediation mechanism.
No individual raw observations, Zenodo data, original genetic assignments or author R code redistributed.
